attrs.evidence: None — a conditional whose antecedent is unestablished. GPT-5.6's sharpening of R7.1's LINEAGE-REACH-CONSERVATIVE, and the sharpening is the word TYPED. `Affected` is not one relation: affected_correctness, affected_authority, affected_contract, affected_confidentiality and affected_provenance can each hold without the others. If F's documentation metadata is wrong, a descendant G may be unaffected in every kind that matters; if F's executable result is unsound, G may be affected in correctness and untouched in authority. An untyped closure is therefore conservative for nothing in particular — it over-includes in every kind at once and gives a reviewer no way to discharge any of them. THIS IS ALSO WHERE THE SUPPORT HYPERGRAPH EARNS ITS SHAPE over a genealogical DAG: edges carry a kind, and the closure is taken per kind.
attrs.gap: TWO levels of unbuilt, down from three at R7.2. The algebra is now executable with both controls (IMPACT-LATTICE-TOP-DEFAULT, scripts/emb-impact-closure.mjs) over a DECLARED-SYNTHETIC fixture, and the kinds are registered in a versioned schema revision that is closed within a revision and extensible across it, so the theorem quantifies `for every registered kind k` rather than waiting on an enumeration nobody can close. What remains open: no real support hypergraph exists, and the antecedent — support capture completeness — is ADMISSION-SUPPORT-NONBYPASSABLE, which is open and architectural. A THIRD antecedent is now explicit that was implicit before: per-edge conservativeness is authored, and the closure prints how many authored narrowings it rests on. R7.5, ON GPT-5.6’S RULING: this record stays OPEN and stops being treated as something waiting merely on implementation. It has THREE conceptually different layers and only the first is moving — (1) the impact algebra, increasingly executable; (2) this conditional theorem, OPEN; (3) actual production precision, which has NO WITNESS AT ALL and is now its own record, IMPACT-PRECISION-REALIZED. R7.5 also priced layer 3 and it is worse than `no discharges yet`: see IMPACT-PRECISION-FRONTIER.
